name: Sacramento headquarters campus
geometry_basis: 840×600 ft fictional study envelope, x east/y north. R01 measured composition retained. Feet converted exactly with 1 ft=0.3048 m; no parcel selection, survey transform, ownership or completion claim.

assumptions.statement: R01 controls four-building composition, dimensions and 362 workplaces/60 single rooms. Internal plans on seven remaining levels are explicit R02 design extensions, not accepted as-built conditions.
2026 actual company employment, campus assigned staff, shift attendance and construction dates remain unknown. Fitted staff workplaces and meeting/learning/dining/bed capacities never create people.
237J2 authorized billets include35 Education and 28HQ. JAG remains six five-person teams, not twelve staff from 12 touchdown desks. Full current named-person bridge preserved.
120 day learners is a simultaneous cap;48 resident cohort members are inside it. Residence has separate night capacity 60, including12 faculty/visitor rooms.
252 drawn parking bays precede accessible-bay conversion. Mode shares, transport demand and event overflow remain unresolved. Parking drawing is not a resolved supply-demand balance.
Primary production/Alexandria compute remains third-party colocation direction outside campus. A service rooms contain only local edge, communications and workplace support.

access.parking_basis: R01 drawn bays before accessible conversion; transport/event demand unresolved.
access.basis: R01 coordinated schematic access, not civil engineering. Railways outside campus; no new track. Public arrivals separated from J2 threshold and quiet residence court.

adjacency.reason: One production kitchen in C serves C and A commons; catering via exterior service route.
J2 remains institutionally outside ESS; staff and visitors use controlled J2 threshold.
Separate educational and residential arrivals;48 resident trainees count inside 120 day learners.
Coordination without making corporate or J2 premises a pass-through.

expansion_strategy.statement: Preserve the four-building R01 composition; no extra wing/building or future workplaces allocated without a successor study.2031/2036 hold-flat capacity is conditional, not a growth forecast.

stormwater_utilities.statement: Perimeter/quad landscape remains available for civil study; exact stormwater volumes, utility loads, connections, fire access turning and accessible routes await engineering.

attendance_scenarios.basis: Simultaneous design scenario:362 workplace users,4 shared hospitality attendees,120 learners,12 client visitors in A-L01 and 6 J2 visitors in B-L01 =504. Learners concentrate in C-L01; day D empty because residents move to program. These are anonymous attendance assumptions, not payroll or new hiring. Meeting and dining users move between rooms without multiplying people.
Separate night-residency capacity; does not add60 to daytime event.
R01 envelope held flat for five-year capacity planning; no authorized workforce growth.
R01 envelope held flat for ten-year capacity planning; future growth/transport/siting unresolved.

phases.name: R01 visual baseline
phases.dependency: Four buildings, ten floors, 362 workplaces and 60 single rooms. Approval records a planning design, not land tenure or construction.

phases.name: R02 source and floor extensions
phases.dependency: Retain the approved master and three reference floors. Seven other floors are explicitly modelled design extensions with fixed stacked cores.

phases.name: Parcel and engineering
phases.dependency: Supported parcel, tenure, utilities, accessibility, transport demand and civil/structural/fire engineering remain unresolved.

phases.name: Procurement, construction and occupancy
phases.dependency: No procurement, permit, construction, fit-out or occupancy date is asserted. Execution requires supported decisions and technical approvals.

phases.name: 2031 and 2036 capacity review
phases.dependency: Both planning horizons retain 362 fitted workplaces and 60 rooms. Future workforce growth and additional floor capacity are unknown; no future construction is implied.
